notes: GHS143 is the sole star retained as a Galactic-unbound candidate by the authors in their final classification (T:p5-b2); its Gaia DR3 identifier is given in T:p22-b0. GHS22, GHS33, GHS37, GHS58, and GHS64 were identified as unbound in Paper I but are found bound in the present analysis; they are therefore included as follow_up rather than candidates_found (T:p4-b9). Their Gaia DR3 identifiers come from T:p20-b1 and T:p21-b0. No other individually studied star is identified as a current or previous Galactic-unbound candidate.

GHS143: For GHS143, the paper numerically reports the total galactocentric space velocity, quoted as 1439.8 km/s (T:p4-b9) and ∼1440 km/s (T:p5-b12), with a total uncertainty of 438 km/s (T:p5-b13). No numerical right ascension, declination, distance, parallax, proper motion, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probability is given for this star. The statement that it is unbound is a classification, not a probability. The value parallax_over_error = 2.7 at T:p5-b13 is not a parallax measurement.

GHS22: The target star GHS22 (Gaia DR3 6425686935027126016) is identified in Table A.1 (T:p20-b1). The only individual result given for it is qualitative: in Sect. 4 it is stated that GHS22 was indicated as unbound in Paper I but is found to be bound in the present analysis (T:p4-b9, quote: “Stars GHS22, GHS33, GHS37, GHS58, GHS64 were indicated as unbound in Paper I, while they are found to be bound in the present analysis.”). No numerical value or probability is reported for any of the requested quantities, so none are recorded.

GHS33: GHS33 (Gaia DR3 5371147153902398080) appears in Table A.1 (T:p20-b1) and is discussed only qualitatively in T:p4-b9: it was indicated as unbound in Paper I but is found bound in the present analysis. The supplied material reports no numerical value for its position, distance, parallax, proper motion, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, Galactic rest-frame speed, or bound/unbound probability; therefore no quantities are recorded.

GHS37: The target star GHS37 (Gaia DR3 5792409434759815680) is only mentioned in T:p4-b9: "Stars GHS22, GHS33, GHS37, GHS58, GHS64 were indicated as unbound in Paper I, while they are found to be bound in the present analysis." No numerical values for right ascension, declination, distance, parallax, proper motions, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, Galactic rest-frame velocity, or bound/unbound probability are reported specifically for GHS37. Its Gaia DR3 identifier is confirmed in Table A.1 (T:p20-b1). The statement about being bound is a qualitative classification, not a reported probability.

GHS58: Target GHS58 (Gaia DR3 4924385446036517760) appears in Table A.1 (T:p20-b1) only as an identifier. T:p4-b9 states that GHS58 was indicated as unbound in Paper I but is found to be bound in the present analysis; no numerical bound or unbound probability, nor any per-star astrometric, distance, radial-velocity, or velocity values, are reported. No eligible quantities were extracted.

GHS64: GHS64 is identified by its Gaia DR3 source ID in Table A.1 (T:p21-b0), and Sect. 4 (T:p4-b9) states that GHS64 was indicated as unbound in Paper I but is found to be bound in the present analysis. No numerical position, parallax, distance, proper-motion, radial-velocity, galactocentric-radius, Galactic-rest-frame-speed, or bound/unbound probability value is reported specifically for GHS64 in the supplied material.
